programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: A look at the men and women who've run and, in some cases, won the Oval Office.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.sub-title: How to Get Away with It
programme.desc: A look at some of history's criminals, con artists, frauds and fakes, from Adam Worth, the 19th-century inspiration for Professor Moriarty, to a jewel thief named Diamond Doris and a count who sold the Eiffel Tower to gullible buyers twice.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: A look at espionage; meeting spies from Delilah to Roald Dahl and along the way revealing the real model for James Bond.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: A look at wars that lasted for centuries and others that were over in minutes, as well as the difficulty of ending a war; the possibility of starting a war over almost anything, from an unprovoked invasion to a lost ear, a pastry or a stolen bucket.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: Throughout history, men and women have dedicated themselves to raking in wealth in the form of old money, new money and blood money; a look at how they got it, spent it and how it affected their happiness, from Robber Barons to Mansa Musa of Mali.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: Exploring why, from Liz Taylor to Attila the Hun, pain doesn't stop people from looking for love; how love is a driver of history, costing royalty their heads, generals their victories, and many people their sanity.

programme.title: Undercover Angel
programme.desc: A young girl prays for an angel to help her mother restore their home. But they get more than what they bargained for.

programme.title: The Wishing Well
programme.desc: A jaded journalist (Jordan Ladd) travels to a small town to write a piece about its reportedly magic wishing well. While at the well, she and a young girl (Jadin Gould) make the same wish and set off an unusual series of events that shows the woman how her life could be different. Jason London, Ernest Borgnine, Sally Kellerman, Yeardley Smith and Charles Shaughnessy also star. Directed by David Jackson.

programme.title: Time Capsule
programme.desc: After 10 years, a group of high school friends reunite at their alma mater's field house to dig up their time capsule. When they open the time capsule they decide to relive their fun high school moments which inspire a newfound relationship.

programme.title: Resting Place
programme.desc: Story about a major (John Lithgow) who battles racism while trying to bury a black Vietnam hero in an all-white cemetery. Luther: Morgan Freeman. Ada: C.C.H. Pounder. Eudora: Frances Sternhagen. Sam: G.D. Spradlin. Sarge: M. Emmet Walsh. Hauer: Richard Bradford. Directed on location by John Korty.

programme.title: Though None Go with Me
programme.desc: Elizabeth Leroy devotes her life to serving God but her faith is tested over the years as she has to overcome many hardships and sorrows.

programme.title: This Magic Moment
programme.desc: An aspiring screenwriter pretends to date a starlet who's trying to make her ex jealous. As the duo keep up their ruse, the lines between fact and fiction begin to blur and romantic entanglements ensue.

programme.title: Uncorked
programme.desc: A workaholic (Julie Benz) finds herself in unfamiliar territory after her schedule unexpectedly clears during a business trip to California's wine country. She starts spending time with a local chef (Scott Elrod) and his eccentric family, who try to teach her that there's more to life than work. JoBeth Williams and Elliott Gould also star. Directed by David Cass Sr.

programme.title: Perfect on Paper
programme.desc: A book editor embarks on a fresh start in work and romance after relocating to Los Angeles, where she learns about not judging a book by its cover after meeting two intriguing men: a surfer and a lawyer.

programme.title: Generation Gap
programme.desc: A rebellious teen (Alex Black) reluctantly spends the summer with his strict war-veteran grandfather (Ed Asner). While the two clash at first, they soon bring about positive changes in each other that lead to new friendships and experiences. Rue McClanahan, Catherine Mary Stewart, Ralph Waite. Directed by Bill L. Norton.

programme.title: Love Will Keep Us Together
programme.desc: After years of hiring housekeepers to run his home, a single advertising executive loses his job and becomes a stay-at-home dad. His new role gives him a different perspective on his family, but a tempting job offer threatens to lead him back to his old workaholic ways.

programme.title: The Seven Year Hitch
programme.desc: A slacker tries to prevent his best friend and roommate from marrying the wrong man by claiming their seven-year cohabitation makes them common-law spouses.

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: When Bob Hart, a widowed police detective trying to raise a rebellious teenage daughter, inherits a Montana horse ranch, he jumps at the opportunity to leave Los Angeles for the open range. Soon after arriving, Bob accepts the position as county sheriff and discovers that the seemingly bucolic countryside is far from tranquil. His problems include wolves who attack his stock, ruthless developers trying to take over the town and a female veterinarian with a chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: Casa Vita
programme.desc: An Iowa farmer who moved to LA to attend a major league baseball camp romances the chef at the restaurant where he works. His future looks bright until an injury threatens his dream.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: Kate is part of a writing duo with her boyfriend, and thinks her author days are over when they split, until her publisher requests a sequel.

programme.title: Class
programme.desc: A rich law student (Justin Bruening) must help a single mom (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) find a job with benefits as part of an assignment for his public-advocacy class. Though the pair clash at first, they soon realize they aren't so different and that they each need to go after the careers they truly want. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: Perfect on Paper
programme.desc: A book editor embarks on a fresh start in work and romance after relocating to Los Angeles, where she learns about not judging a book by its cover after meeting two intriguing men: a surfer and a lawyer.

programme.title: Generation Gap
programme.desc: A rebellious teen (Alex Black) reluctantly spends the summer with his strict war-veteran grandfather (Ed Asner). While the two clash at first, they soon bring about positive changes in each other that lead to new friendships and experiences. Rue McClanahan, Catherine Mary Stewart, Ralph Waite. Directed by Bill L. Norton.

programme.title: Love Will Keep Us Together
programme.desc: After years of hiring housekeepers to run his home, a single advertising executive loses his job and becomes a stay-at-home dad. His new role gives him a different perspective on his family, but a tempting job offer threatens to lead him back to his old workaholic ways.

programme.title: The Seven Year Hitch
programme.desc: A slacker tries to prevent his best friend and roommate from marrying the wrong man by claiming their seven-year cohabitation makes them common-law spouses.

programme.title: Wild Hearts
programme.desc: When Bob Hart, a widowed police detective trying to raise a rebellious teenage daughter, inherits a Montana horse ranch, he jumps at the opportunity to leave Los Angeles for the open range. Soon after arriving, Bob accepts the position as county sheriff and discovers that the seemingly bucolic countryside is far from tranquil. His problems include wolves who attack his stock, ruthless developers trying to take over the town and a female veterinarian with a chip on her shoulder.

programme.title: Casa Vita
programme.desc: An Iowa farmer who moved to LA to attend a major league baseball camp romances the chef at the restaurant where he works. His future looks bright until an injury threatens his dream.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: Kate is part of a writing duo with her boyfriend, and thinks her author days are over when they split, until her publisher requests a sequel.

programme.title: Class
programme.desc: A rich law student (Justin Bruening) must help a single mom (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe) find a job with benefits as part of an assignment for his public-advocacy class. Though the pair clash at first, they soon realize they aren't so different and that they each need to go after the careers they truly want. Directed by Dave S. Cass Sr.

programme.title: After the Fall
programme.desc: A talented equestrian (Andrea Bowen) is paralyzed after an accident and must go through physical therapy in hopes of someday walking again. During the recovery process, she befriends a rough-around-the-edges patient (Fiona Dourif) and her neighbor (Rick Malambri), a former rodeo cowboy who encourages her to return to horseback riding. Directed by Bradford May.

programme.title: A View from Here
programme.desc: A journalist (Laura Leighton) returns to her rural hometown to visit her ailing mother (Angie Dickinson) and discovers that many of the area's farmers are selling their land to a casino developer because of an extreme drought. Directed by Stephen W. Bridgewater.

programme.title: Just Desserts
programme.desc: To save his family bakery, a Bronx baker (Costas Mandylor) with a flair for pastries partners with a talented Manhattan pastry chef (Lauren Holly) to enter a dessert competition with a $250,000 grand prize. Uncle Fabrizio: David Proval. Jim: Bruce Thomas. Jacques Du Jacques: Andy Lauer.

programme.title: Miles From Nowhere
programme.desc: A high-school football player (Andrew Lawrence) copes with his best friend's death by training to run a sub-four-minute mile. But his quest puts him at odds with his father (Treat Williams) after he begins to neglect football. Joanna Going also stars. Directed by David Burton Morris.

programme.title: Fielder's Choice
programme.desc: A perfectionist adman (Chad Lowe) becomes a surrogate dad when the death of his sister lands his rambunctious nephew (K'Sun Ray) in his care. George Segal. Holly: Marin Hinkle.

programme.title: Home Fires Burning
programme.desc: Slice of Americana about the impact of WWII on a Southern hamlet. Barnard Hughes. Pastine: Sada Thompson. Rosh: Robert Prosky. Henry: Bill Pullman. Francine: Elizabeth Berridge. Lonnie: Neil Patrick Harris. Billy: Kyle Chandler. Hilton: Wallace Wilkinson. Filmed in Georgia. Adapted by Robert Inman from his novel. Directed by Glenn Jordan.

programme.title: Diagnosis Delicious
programme.desc: A disgraced chef and an ambitious cardiologist who can't even boil water cross paths when she takes his cooking class. Now she must convince the hot-headed chef to teach her hospital's new Healthy Living seminars, but he has another idea.

programme.title: Love's Unending Legacy
programme.desc: Missie three years later: being a single mother after her husband Willie was shot during a poker scuffle. She and Maddy move back in with her parents Clark and Marty. programme.desc: After spending years in the military, a young man returns to his hometown to take over operation of his ailing grandmother's bed-and-breakfast, where he must contend with an old flame who's scheming to get the property turned into a mall.

programme.desc: A young lawyer works for six weeks at a vineyard to inherit it.

programme.desc: A jaded journalist (Jordan Ladd) travels to a small town to write a piece about its reportedly magic wishing well. While at the well, she and a young girl (Jadin Gould) make the same wish and set off an unusual series of events that shows the woman how her life could be different. Jason London, Ernest Borgnine, Sally Kellerman, Yeardley Smith and Charles Shaughnessy also star. Directed by David Jackson.

programme.desc: A manicurist predicts that an unlucky-at-love lawyer will meet the love of her life and he will be a Michael, so the attorney begins a series of dates with men with that name.

programme.desc: A new homeowner learns that her property is where the first Thanksgiving took place, and then she must fight to keep her house because a historian wants to raze it in order to study the historic site.

programme.desc: A lone officer desperately seeks a nanny for two children awaiting foster care, while Libby, jobless in LA, grapples with her future. Their paths cross due to a petty theft.

programme.sub-title: 2025 Eastern Conference First Round: Milwaukee Bucks at Indiana Pacers

programme.title: NBA Playoff Playback
programme.sub-title: 2025 Eastern Conference Semifinals: Indiana Pacers at Cleveland Cavaliers
programme.desc: Game 2. Tyrese Haliburton made a 3-pointer with 1.1 seconds remaining as the Pacers scored the final eight points in 47.9 seconds to stun the short-handed and top-seeded Cavs 120-119 to take a 2-0 lead in their Eastern Conference semifinals series.

programme.title: Bob Marley: One Love
programme.desc: Biographical music drama starring Kingsley Ben-Adir. In the late 1970s, after being shot and badly wounded on stage in Jamaica, reggae star Bob Marley decamps to the UK, where he and his band work on the album that will make him a global icon.

programme.title: Oppenheimer
programme.desc: Biographical drama starring Cillian Murphy and Emily Blunt. During the Second World War, American physicist J Robert Oppenheimer and fellow scientists race against time to develop an atomic bomb before the Nazis. But, during the 1950s Red Scare, his name is dragged through the mud by US officials.

programme.title: A Star Is Born
programme.desc: Musical romantic drama starring Lady Gaga and Bradley Cooper. Rock star Jackson Maine meets aspiring songwriter Ally, a waitress who moonlights as a bar singer. Mesmerised by Ally's talent, Jackson invites her to perform with him and she becomes a sensation. The two begin a romantic relationship, but their happiness is threatened as an increasingly washed-up Jackson grapples with substance abuse issues.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
programme.desc: Futuristic action adventure starring Tom Hardy and Charlize Theron. In a world where water is precious and humanity faces extinction, a one-armed woman takes off across the desert with a lorry-load of females who've been imprisoned to bear children. Riding shotgun is Max, the infamous "Road Warrior".

programme.title: A Quiet Place: Day One
programme.desc: Sci-fi horror prequel starring Lupita Nyong'o and Joseph Quinn. New York City is suddenly attacked by terrifying alien creatures with super-sensitive hearing. Sam, a terminally ill cancer patient, and law student Eric are among those who have survived the initial assault - but how long can they remain alive when the faintest noise can be deadly?

programme.title: Dune: Part Two
programme.desc: Epic sci-fi drama starring Timothée Chalamet and Zendaya. With the evil Harkonnen family back in charge of Arrakis, deposed heir Paul Atreides and his mother have taken refuge with the native Fremen in the planet's perilous desert wasteland. Paul becomes close with Fremen warrior Chani and begins to demonstrate powers that persuade her people to aid in the young man's plan to avenge his father and take back control.

programme.title: Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire
programme.desc: Supernatural adventure starring Paul Rudd, featuring Bill Murray and Dan Aykroyd. The spook-hunting Spengler family joins forces with the original Ghostbusters, whose work is continuing via a secret research lab. When an ancient artefact is discovered and releases an evil force, the team must work together to prevent the dawning of a new Ice Age.

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Romantic comedy starring Tom Cruise, Cuba Gooding Jr and Renee Zellweger. As a top agent at Sports Management International, Jerry Maguire knows his way around and is his own man... until one day he gets an attack of decency and finds himself out of a job. Now he must start from scratch. His only allies are a single mother, her cheeky young son and a second-rate player for the Arizona Cardinals.

programme.desc: When the commander of his old military unit is arrested on trumped-up spy charges, vigilante Tom Cruise must save the day. Action sequel.

programme.title: The Equalizer 3
programme.desc: In Italy, Robert McCall protects his new friends by taking on the mafia. Action thriller starring Denzel Washington.

programme.title: Murder By Numbers
programme.desc: Sandra Bullock is the seasoned cop on the trail of the privileged high-schoolers who think they've committed the perfect crime. Psychological thriller with Ryan Gosling.

programme.title: The Da Vinci Code
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Audrey Tautou race across Europe in a bid to uncover a secret. Mystery thriller based on the Dan Brown novel. Violence/sex.

programme.title: Along Came A Spider
programme.desc: Still recovering from his partner's death, forensic psychologist Morgan Freeman reluctantly returns to the job to hunt a killer. Strong language/violence/flashing images.
